close_time_cross_family_audit.note: close_time IS rewritten across captures (L360/L361, always EARLIER). The settlement_ledger-only check in `substrate` cannot see this and must not be read as evidence that the entry anchor was knowable ex ante.

l51_differentiation.note: S82's entry prices are read from a family S79 never touches, so no entry price is shared and the two populations cannot be sign-negations of each other. The mechanisms remain complementary in SIGN; the measurements are not the same measurement.

preregistration.flow_sign_convention: +count when the taker BUYS yes, -count when the taker buys no
preregistration.game_ticker_rule: argmax |rho| over the game's traded tickers; ties -> min(ticker)
preregistration.signal: rho = net_signed_count / total_count over the window, on one ticker
